acceptedAnswer.text: Trip Delay is a coverage on most Travel Guard travel insurance plans that provides you with coverage for certain reasonable costs, which may include lodging and food, when you can’t reach your destination due to a covered, Unforeseen delay or cancellation.

mainEntity.name: How do I use Trip Delay coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you experience a significant delay in your travels (length of time varies by plan), save any receipts for necessary items you purchase until you’re able to get to your destination. You can file a claim to request reimbursement for those expenses. To confirm which expenses are covered, be sure to review your plan’s complete terms and conditions.

mainEntity.name: Can I receive Trip Delay benefits if my trip is cancelled?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the Trip Delay coverage is only active while you are already traveling and provides reimbursement for the covered costs associated with the delay in getting your trip back on track.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Trip Delay coverage if I miss my flight?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trip Delay does not provide coverage for flights missed of your own accord unless there was a traffic accident on the way to your departure flight, in which case a police report verifying the incident will be required when filing your claim.

Missed Connection is a coverage on most Travel Guard travel insurance plans that provides coverage when you miss your departure due to a Common Carrier (like an airline) delay. It typically covers for certain additional transportation costs associated with getting you back to your trip and for covered unused trip costs if you miss portions of your trip entirely.

mainEntity.name: How do I use Missed Connection coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you experience a missed connection, save any receipts for costs associated with catching up with your trip. If you need assistance getting to your destination, Travel Guard’s 24-hour emergency travel assistance team can help with last-minute arrangements. You can file a claim to request reimbursement for those covered expenses you incurred.

mainEntity.name: Can I file a Missed Connection claim if I’m at fault for my delay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel Guard provides Missed Connection coverage for missed departures caused by Common Carrier delay or for Inclement Weather. It is crucial to keep track of your schedule and to allow plenty of time to realistically make your connection (assuming your travels go smoothly). This coverage will not be applicable if the insured’s travel arrangements allow less than one hour between connections for domestic travel or less than two hours between international connections, as travelers will have known the risks of short layover times when booking.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to use the same carrier for the Missed Connections benefit?

acceptedAnswer.text:
No, your rescheduled connection trip can be with a different carrier to help get your trip back on track as soon as possible.

Filing a claim for Trip Delay or Missed Connection

mainEntity.name: What documentation do I need to file a claim for Trip Delay or Missed Connection?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The specific documentation needed for your Trip Delay or Missed Connection claim will depend on the reason for delay/missed connection and any expenses incurred because of it. Below is a list of documentation that may be required.

- Travel Guard claim form

- Travel itinerary showing original details of insured trip

- Common Carrier report

- Receipts for expenses being claimed

There may be additional documents required based on your specific claim. You can start the process of filing a claim online with our claims portal or you can call us directly if you have specific questions.
